title: ViSeRet: A simple yet effective approach to moment retrieval via fine-grained video segmentation

evidence.quote: We present a simple yet effective approach to jointly tackle two video-text retrieval tasks (video retrieval and video corpus moment retrieval) by leveraging the model trained only on the video retrieval task.
